entities.summary: Wilmer Francisco Difo is a Dominican professional baseball infielder who is a free agent. Difo made his Major League Baseball (MLB) debut in 2015 with the Washington Nationals and has also played for the Pittsburgh Pirates. He has made the majority of his major league appearances as a second baseman, shortstop, or third baseman, with more limited stints as an outfielder.
